ns2:section.sectionText: Global Studies: Diversity and Integration in Istanbul. This course focuses on Istanbuls unique history as the crossroads between Europe and Asia, surveying its beginnings as an outpost of the Roman Empire to its role as a center for global trade to its modern day issues, such as its proposal to enter the European Union and its role in the Middle East conflicts. More information at: http://www.las.uiuc.edu/coursesabroad/winter.html. The course starts during the 2nd 8 weeks term and is completed in Istanbul 12/26-1/13. First year Discovery Program course. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
